top_signals.title: Commission takes new steps to prepare Europeans for growing crisis risks
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 03 Nov 2026 As Europe faces increasingly frequent and complex crises, the European Commission is stepping up efforts to strengthen preparedness across the EU. From helping citizens protect themselves during emergencies to ensuring that national civil protection systems can keep operating when disaster strikes, the EU is delivering concrete measures to make Europe more resilient.
